title: Software Engineering Intern
workAuthorization: CPT/OPT accepted; visa sponsorship listed for this demo role.
matchSummary: Your demo profile shares React and Python experience with this role.
description: Work with a small engineering team building tools that help people organize their day. You will contribute to the web application and the services behind it.
Pair with a mentor to turn product requirements into clear, maintainable features. Take part in design discussions, code reviews, and short delivery cycles.
The internship includes time to learn the existing system, ship a focused project, and present your work to the team. Collaboration and asking useful questions matter as much as prior experience.
requirements: Pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Familiarity with Git and REST APIs.
Available for the full summer internship.

title: Data Analyst Intern
workAuthorization: Work authorization and sponsorship eligibility must be confirmed with the employer.
matchSummary: The demo profile includes Python and data analysis skills relevant to this role.
description: Help a research operations team understand how its services are used. Prepare reliable datasets and explain what the numbers show.
Work with an analyst to check data quality, build simple reports, and document the assumptions behind your conclusions.
Present a small analysis project at the end of the internship. The work emphasizes careful reasoning and clear communication.
requirements: Experience with Python or another analysis language.
Able to explain findings to a nontechnical audience.

title: Product Design Intern
workAuthorization: Existing U.S. work authorization required; this demo listing does not offer sponsorship.
matchSummary: The demo profile has related product experience; a design portfolio would strengthen the match.
description: Help shape simple mobile experiences for a small product studio. Explore user needs and translate them into testable flows.
Create wireframes and prototypes, discuss tradeoffs with engineering, and revise designs after feedback.
You will own a bounded design problem with guidance from a mentor and share the reasoning behind your final proposal.
requirements: A portfolio showing your design process.
Familiarity with Figma or a similar prototyping tool.

title: Cloud Support Intern
matchSummary: The demo profile has troubleshooting experience; cloud networking is an area to develop.
description: Learn how a platform support team investigates customer issues and keeps useful technical documentation.
Reproduce problems in a safe test environment, collect evidence, and work with engineers to explain the cause.
A mentor will help you learn the platform. Your final project will improve a recurring support workflow or a piece of documentation.
requirements: Familiarity with Linux and basic networking.

title: Frontend Development Intern
workAuthorization: Existing work authorization required for this demo internship.
matchSummary: The demo profile includes JavaScript and React, which are central to this role.
description: Build accessible web interfaces that help a small public-interest team share its work.
Translate approved designs into responsive components and check keyboard interaction, error handling, and small-screen behavior.
Work with a mentor on a complete feature, including tests and documentation, and explain your choices during review.
requirements: Experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Interest in accessibility and responsive design.

title: Quality Engineering Intern
workAuthorization: Sponsorship listed; confirm eligibility and timing with the employer.
matchSummary: The demo profile shows programming experience useful for writing repeatable checks.
description: Help a product team find important problems before a release. Explore features, document clear reproductions, and build repeatable checks.
Work with developers to understand expected behavior and choose useful edge cases instead of testing only the happy path.
Your internship project will improve the reliability of a focused product area and leave clear documentation for the next person.
requirements: Attention to detail when describing a problem.
Interest in automated testing and practical debugging.
